context: Add serviceaccount to the internal identity handling (redact like usernames per #1381), and add key-level public coverage so a non-email value is still pseudonymized.
description: Driven 2026-08-01: sanitize_platform_options({'service_account': 'svc-bench@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com'}) returns the raw email (dataproc_serverless_adapter.py:587 reads this key). The public layer catches it only when the VALUE is email-shaped (PII regex); key-level coverage exists in neither layer. An IAM principal email identifies the project and operator.

preserves.behavior: Already-covered username keys keep current behavior
auth_method / authenticator keep exporting real values (method names, not secrets)
